name: Cassyt
subjectPrompt: A young adult half-elf cleric named Cassyt, earnest, unassuming face and subtly pointed ears, dark auburn hair tied in a practical bun, friendly curious expression. She wears simple ash-gray and charcoal practical cloth robes of a Kelemvor acolyte. A small pewter skeletal-hand-and-scales pendant hangs visibly at her throat. Holds a warm plain oil lantern with one hand and a very small closed old book in the other, dark belt pouch and plain boots. The lantern light is subdued, with an open friendly posture. Do not use heavy armor or skull decorations.

name: Rorreth (Red Wizard)
subjectPrompt: Adult human Red Wizard of Thay Rorreth Monforoth, with a clean-shaven scalp and clear narrow faded black ornamental arcane tattoos curving over the scalp, trim brow, middle-aged angular face with a startled guarded look. Fitted embroidered dusty crimson robes, subtle burnished metallic gold stitching and maroon underside, with simple practical layers under his robe. One hand with a half-closed dark leather haversack slung low, other firmly holding a plain ashwood quarterstaff. No glowing eyes, lich markings or skulls.
